# Alides Qatar

> Alides is a retained, partner-led executive search and board advisory firm based in Doha, serving boards, family-owned groups, government-related entities, institutions and investors in Qatar. Member of ECI Group (international executive search network) and of the AESC (Association of Executive Search and Leadership Consultants). Part of Alides, with offices in Casablanca, Paris and Doha.

Contact: contact@eci-alides.com · +974 5579 0920 · https://qa.alides.org/#contact

## Advisory services
- [Board Advisory & Director Search in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/board-advisory-qatar/): Board composition, independent and non-executive director search in Qatar, aligned with the QFMA governance code. Retained and partner-led, from Doha.
- [CEO Succession Planning in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/ceo-succession-qatar/): CEO succession and leadership continuity in Qatar: planned and sensitive chief executive transitions, from brief to appointment and beyond. Partner-led.
- [Energy & Industrial Executive Search in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/energy-industry-qatar/): Executive search for Qatar's energy, LNG, petrochemical and industrial leaders: CEO, COO, CFO, projects and HSE. Retained and partner-led, from Doha.
- [Executive Search in Doha, Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/executive-search-doha/): Retained, partner-led executive search in Doha for CEO, CFO, CIO, CHRO and COO roles across Qatar's boards, family groups and institutions.
- [Family Business & Family Office Advisory, Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/family-business-family-office-qatar/): Governance, professionalisation and key appointments for Qatar's family-owned groups and family offices: CFO, CIO and executive committees.
- [Financial Services Executive Search in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/financial-services-qatar/): Executive search for Qatar's banks, investment firms, insurers and QFC institutions: CEO, CFO, CRO, compliance and board roles. Retained, from Doha.
- [Executive Assessment & Leadership Advisory, Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/leadership-advisory-qatar/): Independent executive assessment, executive committee design and leadership architecture for boards and principals in Qatar. Partner-led, from Doha.
- [Public Sector & Sovereign Capital Search, Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/public-sector-sovereign-qatar/): Executive search and board advisory for Qatar's government-related entities, sovereign investment platforms and national institutions.
- [Qatarisation & Leadership Pipelines | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/qatarisation-leadership/): Qatarisation as a leadership question: building credible Qatari leaders for boards and executive teams, in line with National Vision 2030.

## Insights
- [Appointing a CEO Today: What Boards Expect | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/appointing-a-ceo-today/): What boards in Qatar expect of a chief executive today: strategic legibility, the capacity to align the top team, and command of the political.
- [Leadership & Governance Insights, Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/): Strategic briefs and perspectives on leadership, CEO succession and board governance in Qatar, written for chairmen, boards and family principals.
- [Institutionalising the Family Office | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/institutionalising-the-family-office/): How families turn an informal organisation into a family office that outlives its founder: the audit, the three separations, the first hire.
- [Leadership Is a System, Not a Competence | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/leadership-is-a-system/): Why leadership at the top is better understood as a system to align than a competence to develop. A perspective on governance and power.
- [Reorganising with Intent: Five Decisions | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/reorganising-with-intent/): Five decisions to weigh before any reorganisation: strategic clarity, the executive committee, succession, talent-to-value and quiet change.
- [Why 70% of Transformations Fall Short | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/the-false-move-of-false-change/): Why close to 70% of transformations fall short, and what distinguishes real change from its appearance. A perspective on leadership and execution.
- [The Silent CEO Crisis: The Board's Blind Spot | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/the-silent-ceo-crisis/): Record turnover, shorter tenures and invisible burnout are reshaping executive leadership. Why it matters for boards and family offices in Qatar.
- [The True Cost of an Appointment | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/the-true-cost-of-an-appointment/): Why a leader's value is decided long after they take office: the economics of an appointment, internal vs external, and the board's duty after signature.
- [Why CEO Successions Fail, and How to Avoid It | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/why-ceo-successions-fail/): Why chief executive successions fail and how boards in Qatar can avoid it: the three recurring errors, and what successful transitions share.
